themes.title: Fuel Policy Rollbacks & Price Backlash
themes.blurb: Right‑wing outlets in the United States and Norway are both highlighting the rollback of fuel‑related standards and the push for tax cuts, framing them as necessary relief for consumers facing soaring prices. The coverage links policy reversals to government overreach and portrays them as a victory for ordinary voters.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration scales back fuel‑efficiency standards for cars and trucks, while critics claim the move harms climate goals.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Progress Party pushes to reinstate fuel‑tax cuts, citing record‑high pump prices and demanding tax relief.
